About Verdentra

We are a team of expert technologists with a shared passion for building technology solutions responsibly, whilst focusing on business outcomes. Our mission is to weave excellence, innovation, and sustainability into the very fabric of the digital landscape, and we specialize in Cloud, Data, AI, and emerging technologies. We maintain solid collaborations with top-tier Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) in the US, providing us with a strong foundation to address complex challenges and deliver business outcomes.

What you’ll gain:

  • Build Cutting-Edge Automation: Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, and beyond.
  • Be a Quality Advocate: Work closely with developers, architects, and product teams to embed quality throughout the SDLC, influencing how products are built, tested, and released.
  • Sharpen Your Expertise: Take on complex testing challenges, from end-to-end automation to performance and reliability, while driving improvements in efficiency and coverage.
  • Collaborate & Grow: Share your insights with peers, contribute to best practices, and continuously upskill in the latest QE tools, DevOps practices, and industry trends.
  • Mentor and Inspire: Lead, mentor, and coach junior QE engineers, sharing your expertise and driving the team’s technical maturity and best practices.
  • Stay Ahead: Explore and adopt emerging QE methodologies and technologies that keep testing practices modern, lean, and impactful.

Who We Are Looking For:

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.4+ years of solid hands-on experience in QE automation tools such as Playwright
  • Proven ability to build and maintain automated testing frameworks and contribute to end-to-end QE strategies.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills to identify root causes quickly and effectively.
  • Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar).
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and working effectively in fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence through expertise.
  • Exposure to AI-driven testing tools and AI-based automation frameworks will be an added advantage.

Ready to take your next step?

We are looking for a detail-oriented and motivated individual to join our team as a Junior QA Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products through effective testing practices and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Key Skills & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT / Software Engineering / Computer Science (Mandatory)
  • Minimum 1+ year of experience in Software Quality Assurance
  • Strong knowledge of manual testing & automation concepts and methodologies (automation tools - Cypress, Playwright)
  • Experience in writing and executing test cases and test scenarios
  • Familiarity with bug tracking tools (e.g., Jira or similar)
  • Good understanding of SDLC and STLC processes
  • Knowledge of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT or similar) to support testing activities
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs and system workflows
  • Familiarity with Git and version control systems
  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Fluent in English with strong communication skills

Additional Skills (Preferred):

  • Familiarity with programming/scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java)
  • Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman)
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines
  • Understanding of performance or security testing basics
  • Experience working in Agile environments

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and execute manual test cases
  • Identify, document, and track bugs effectively
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, and usability testing
  • Collaborate with developers and product teams to ensure product quality
  • Assist in maintaining test documentation and reports
  • Utilize AI tools to improve testing efficiency and productivity
  • Support test automation efforts where applicable
  • Troubleshoot issues and ensure timely resolution

If this opportunity matches your profile, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are looking for an Associate QA Engineer who is passionate about software quality and wants to play an active role in delivering reliable, scalable, and high-quality software products.

What We're Looking For

  • 1+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing

  • Basic experience or understanding of test automation

  • Understanding of microservices and distributed systems is an advantage

  • Familiarity with AWS or cloud-based applications is an advantage

What You'll Do

  • Analyze requirements and identify potential quality risks
  • Create detailed test scenarios and test cases
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing
  • Test REST APIs and backend services
  • Perform database validation using SQL
  • Identify, document, and track defects using Jira
  • Work closely with developers to investigate and reproduce issues
  • Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and other Agile ceremonies
  • Contribute to test automation initiatives
  • Perform regression testing for new releases
  • Validate fixes and ensure defects are properly resolved
  • Support release and deployment validation
  • Continuously improve QA processes and testing practices

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on real-world SaaS and fintech-oriented products
  • Exposure to modern web applications, APIs, microservices, and cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience with modern QA and automation practices
  • Collaborative environment with experienced engineers
  • Opportunities to develop both technical and QA skills
  • Career growth opportunities within the engineering team

If you are passionate about software quality and want to grow as a modern QA Engineer while working on real-world products, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of our engineering team.

WHO WE ARE

At Haulmatic, we transcend boundaries with a pioneering spirit of transformation. Our mission extends beyond traditional software; we lead the charge in revolutionizing supply chain digitization, transforming logistics, transportation, and everything beyond.

HOW WE WORK

Our working environment is fast-paced, demanding, and deeply collaborative.As a QA Engineer at Haulmatic, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality of every shipped product and continuously contributing to customer success by maintaining and improving our quality standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to understand requirements and define testing scope.
  • Write comprehensive test cases, execute tests, report defects, and manage the full bug life cycle.
  • Track defects and report them in JIRA, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
  • Create and maintain test data and test environments to support functional, regression, and exploratory testing activities.
  • Use risk-based and coverage-based testing techniques to maximise test coverage, focusing on the most critical features and flows.
  • Plan and prioritise your work to meet deadlines and deliver under pressure.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, documentation, and best practices.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience as a QA Engineer in the software industry.
  • Strong experience testing Web applications and mobile applications (Android and iOS).
  • Proficiency in using JIRA (or similar tools) for issue tracking and defect management.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, Agile/Scrum environments with tight delivery timelines.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to testing.
  • Enthusiastic, proactive, and a strong team player with a growth mindset.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with test automation (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium or similar).
  • Experience in API testing (Postman, REST clients, or automation-based API tests).
  • Familiarity with SQL and basic database validation.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and integrating tests into build pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Experience in performance, load, or security testing tools is an added advantage.
  • Previous experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or fleet management/TMS domains.
  • Experience with test management tools (e.g. Testiny, TestRail, Zephyr, etc.).

Who We Are

PacificKode is a software development and IT services and consulting company that specializes in robotic engineering, software development, cloud computing, mobile application development, IT consulting, application support and manage services. Our team of experienced engineers and consultants work together to create innovative solutions for our clients that meet their unique business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business analysts and product owners to analyze requirements, identify gaps, and clarify acceptance criteria.
  • Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
  • Execute various types of testing: functional, integration, regression, system, and non-functional.
  • Log, track, and manage defects using tools such as Azure DevOps, ensuring clear reproduction steps and context.
  • Coordinate with developers to reproduce, communicate, and retest issues until resolution.
  • Verify defect fixes and ensure they do not introduce regressions 
  • Maintain and update test documentation, including test data sheets and traceability matrices.
  • Performs tests at all levels of testing and shares the updates with stakeholders.
  • Work closely with the QA Lead to understand feature implementations, discuss testing challenges, and propose improvements.
  • Involved and helped other QA team members in their testing activities.
  • Prepares a daily/weekly progress report for his manager. 
  • Communicate effectively with team members across all levels. (technical and non-technical)

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s degree or BE in Computer Science or MCA.
  • Key skill – Manual Testing, SQL, Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving skills, Leadership skills, Communication and interpersonal skills.
  • 1-2 years hands-on experience in Manual Testing and API Testing.
  • Should have hands on experience on functional testing/Black box testing.
  • Excellent knowledge on QA methodologies and automation tools.
  • Should have hands on experience on writing test cases, test scenarios, test plans & test data generation.
  • Knowledge/experience in of automation testing, performance testing and experience in Azure test plan will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent communication skills, being able to explain complex issues in a way that makes sense to everyone on the team
